We solve business challenges through merch

Promo-Product

For: Marketers and event managers

Situation: «We have a conference in a month and need 2,000 gifts for participants».

Our solution: We select items that look more expensive than they are. We make sure your giveaways don’t end up in the trash at the exit.

Corporate Gifts

For: HR directors and PR professionals

Situation: New Year, onboarding new employees, gifts for partners

Our solution: We create sets that convey care. Together with you, we craft not just a set, but an entire story with thoughtful packaging and meaning.

merch (BRAND WEAR)

For: Brand managers

Situation: "We want our own internal merchandise store" or "We need cool merch for the team".

Our solution: We work like a fashion house — selecting fabrics, developing patterns, and refining color samples within your brand palette. This is clothing people wear out, not just at the office.

Special Projects and Drops (Custom)

For: Creative directors and influencer marketers

Situation: Collaboration, limited collection, or seeding for bloggers

Our solution: A full R&D cycle. We design and produce what doesn’t exist in catalogs: complex electronics, custom shapes, and unconventional materials.

Supply

For: Procurement teams and operations directors

Situation: "We have a ready specification for 5,000 items and need them sourced, delivered, and cleared through customs".

Our solution: We act as your external procurement team. We source factories, manage quality control, and deliver turnkey solutions. Minimal creativity, maximum efficiency.

6 steps to perfect merchandise

01
Brief without a brief
Forget long spreadsheets and detailed specs
Just tell us in your own words: who the merch is for, the occasion, timeline, and budget. We’ll ask the right questions and create the brief, saving your time.
02
Proposal and estimate
WE PREPARE THE SOLUTION IN A FORMAT THAT WORKS FOR YOU
If you need to impress management, we create a polished presentation with mockups. If numbers matter, we provide a clear estimate. Most importantly, you immediately see real timelines, budget options, and transparent terms. It includes only what addresses your specific business goals.
03
Test run before launch
Sample prototype based on your design
To ensure expectations match reality, we can create a sample prototype based on your design, or approve a sample via photo or video. This is your safeguard: you can check materials and printing quality before we start full production.
04
Production without «language barriers»
We start the production run
Our China managers communicate with factories clearly — both linguistically and culturally. This lets us quickly resolve issues, negotiate the best terms, and avoid miscommunication. If needed, we can arrange an independent quality check.
05
Logistics and foreign trade
We handle all the paperwork
Customs clearance, documents, and certificates. We choose the route to deliver your cargo on time and without hidden surprises.
06
Order receipt
We deliver the batch to you
The best part: you open the boxes and see the exact product shown in the visualization. Colors, textures, and details — exactly as we planned together.

Faq

Not at all. Apparel is only a small part of what we do — it’s not our main focus. Our strength is creating complex items from scratch. We create custom notebooks, gadgets, unique bottles, travel kits, electronics, and intricate metal and ceramic souvenirs. If you can imagine it, we can produce it. We create complete products — not just logos printed on blanks.
Of course. Our design studio will refine your idea, adapt the design for the actual product, and even create a unique shape from scratch.
We have chosen China because it offers an unparalleled technological base and a complete R&D cycle. This allows us to bring even the most unconventional designs to life with a level of precision, material variety, and cost-efficiency that is currently unavailable in the local UAE market. Our presence in China ensures that your brand receives a truly unique product, not just a logo printed on a generic blank.
For unique merchandise, this is almost impossible. In 2 weeks, you can only buy ready-made stock in UAE and quickly apply a logo — but that’s not what we do. In China, every order is made from scratch specifically for you. To produce a high-quality product with a custom design, we usually need about 2 months. This time covers the full production cycle: development, sample creation, batch production, and logistics to your warehouse. We focus on quality, not speed.
We love bold ideas, but we love physics and common sense even more. Often, what looks great in a render is impossible to produce (or would cost as much as an airplane wing).

Our superpower is adapting ideas. We take your imagination and "translate" it for the factory: selecting the right materials and production methods so the product looks amazing, is manufacturable, and reasonably priced. We get as close as possible to your vision, while respecting technical limits.
Let’s be clear. There’s the "pig in a poke" approach on AliExpress, and there’s proper industrial production in China. We operate in the second category. We select the factory to match your budget and requirements — from simple workshops to high-tech production facilities. Before starting the batch, you can always approve a sample — the standard for the entire run. You get exactly the quality you approved. No surprises.
That’s exactly what we do 100% of the time. We aren’t limited by OAE warehouses. We work directly with factories in China, so we can produce a gadget with a unique shape or a notebook from materials never seen in UAE. We create a fully custom product, not resell stock.
We base orders on the project budget, not on quantity. Our minimum order budget starts from 14000 AED.

The number of items within this budget can vary — it depends on the unit cost. It could be a large batch of inexpensive stickers or a small run of complex electronics.

What matters is that the total budget allows us to launch production properly.
